sourceBindings.text: Order the five report sections and turn an unexplained result into a farmer-readable table row with source and units.
Explain pH, NPK, OM and CEC to a partner in two minutes, then revise an inaccurate statement.
Build the West Field case report with prioritized conditional actions and peer review.
Calculate Field B's mean 6.24 while preserving all five readings and unknown date.
Inspect the Paddock 3 one-page product against all five trainer checklist rows; do not self-sign the trainer record.

Review a partner's West Field or Paddock 3 draft against the source case and five sections. Mark a missing fact or method, a reasoning error, and a concrete correction. Then re-rate confidence 1–5 for planning only.
Only a real trainer can record the Paddock 3 product-card yes/no, observation, corrective action and sign-off.
These are teaching fixtures, not your measurements. Keep dates, laboratory and field observations unknown where absent. Example reference ranges below are not local laboratory thresholds.
Write your own five-section report attempt and one critique for this case, marking unknown facts explicitly. Completeness and meaning are not checked automatically.
The comparison checks no free-text meaning and certifies no practical skill.

sourceBindings.text: Paddock 3: five-row trainer product card
Report identifies Paddock 3
All five results pH/OM/N/P/K listed
Plain language explains the findings
At least one specific deficiency-related action with evidence; the source’s bone-meal example requires crop/lab/site qualification
Report is organized, legible and professional
Trainer record remains unobserved and unsigned. The five original product criteria are preserved; no learner click records a trainer decision.

This step assesses a report and peer review; no new field skill is certified. The Paddock 3 product card retains its five original trainer checklist rows and requires an actual reviewer to mark evidence and any corrective action.

The overview is 60 active minutes: 5 introduction + 10 concepts + 35 writing + 10 discussion. The facilitation notes also name a 5-minute setup; arrange it within preparation rather than silently adding a different total. Groups of 3–4; 15- and 5-minute warnings; a 2-minute partner explanation fits within practice. Compare models only after attempts and critique. Prepared tables/sentence starters are support, not evidence of independent table construction.
